query: INSERT INTO whatsapp_group_roster(binding_id,observed_at,metadata) SELECT b.id,$3,$4 FROM whatsapp_group_binding b JOIN whatsapp_group_membership m ON m.binding_id=b.id WHERE b.group_jid=$1 AND m.account_id=$2 AND m.consent_ended_at IS NULL AND b.id=ANY($5) ON CONFLICT(binding_id) DO UPDATE SET metadata=excluded.metadata,observed_at=excluded.observed_at WHERE whatsapp_group_roster.observed_at<excluded.observed_at
